facts.fact: The board of the national regulator ARN-TIC put the draft Electronic Transactions Law (covering electronic communications and transactions, trust services and e-government) out for public consultation, with responses due by 28 May 2026; the notice's date is not given, so the published date 2026-05-08 is used.
